mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may increase cardiovascular risk and modafinil can increase heart rate/blood pressure; additionally, modafinil may inhibit CYP2C9 potentially elevating meloxicam levels, and NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow which could affect modafinil clearance.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and renal function periodically; consider alternative pain management if cardiovascular or renal concerns exist.
